profile.headline: Principal Software Engineering Manager | Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am a passionate and versatile leader in the field of product and software development. As the General Manager and Chief Technology Officer at Fieldster, a leading provider of field service management solutions, I aim to deliver value to our customers, partners, and stakeholders through continuous improvement, collaboration, and innovation. I thrive on creating and nurturing a high-performance team culture, where everyone can grow, learn, and contribute to our shared vision and mission.

In my dual role as GM and CTO, I have spearheaded the development and implementation of key performance indicators for sales, customer success, and product teams, enhancing overall team performance and accountability. I have also provided support, coaching, and mentorship to managers within these teams, cultivating a collaborative and growth-oriented leadership approach.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
Elevated to the position of General Manager, concurrently maintaining responsibilities as Chief Technology Officer (CTO).

Spearheaded developing and implementing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams, enhancing overall team performance and accountability.

Provided support, coaching, and mentorship to managers within Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams, cultivating a collaborative and growth-oriented leadership approach.

Took a hands-on role as a product manager, guiding product roadmap planning through the effective use of JIRA and Confluence.

Successfully navigated and led the team through an acquisition in September 2023, ensuring continuity and alignment with organizational goals.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Established and nurtured a cross-functional team of full-stack developers and testers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work culture.

Implemented Agile practices, introducing Scrum into the software development life cycle, resulting in increased efficiency and adaptability.

Standardized release cycles, reducing time to value for customers and enhancing overall product delivery.

Collaborated closely with devops to launch an automated deployment system using Jenkins and SQL Server Data Migrations, streamlining deployment processes.

Collaborated closely with customers and the Customer Success team to define and refine a dynamic product roadmap, utilizing JIRA and Confluence.

Mentored developers and testers in organizational and role-based best practices, contributing to skill development and team growth in C#, Javascript/jQuery, ASP.NET MVC, Xamarin, SQL Server, and Redis.
Successfully planned and executed a migration from IBM Cloud to Google Cloud, ensuring a smooth transition and improved overall performance. 

Provided hands-on development support, reinforcing a hands-on leadership approach with expertise in C#, Javascript, jQuery, ASP.NET MVC, Xamarin, SQL Server, and Redis.

positions.title: Director of Software Development
positions.description:
Collaborated with the sales team to drive customer acquisition, providing valuable insights to generate new projects.

Worked closely with customers to gather and define software requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

Developed and maintained diverse customer software,  ranging from web and mobile applications to APIs.  Expertly utilized technologies such as PHP, C#, CakePhp, ASP.NET MVC, Javascript/jQuery, SQL Server, Mysql, and PostgresQL.  Operated in both Linux and Windows environments.

Served as Project Manager for all customer projects, overseeing successful project completion with scope and timelines utilizing JIRA and Basecamp.

Led and mentored a team of three, implementing best practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.  Contributed to the professional growth of team members while maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency.
